d: Long, straight ash-brown hair with blunt bangs and a youthful, mature face. Narrow, sharp purple eyes. A slender build wearing a white hooded jacket with cyan accents and a black underskirt, paired with black thigh-high stockings, black boots, and black fingerless gloves. A black visor with a cyan glowing horizontal line sits on the forehead, and a white futuristic rifle with cyan details is held in the arms.
